content: Hi, how can i assist you today?
My car GPS reroutes me to places I’m thinking about, even if I don’t type them.
Reroutes usually respond to traffic, saved favorites, or calendar destinations. Are those locations in recent searches or calendar events?
They were in recent searches last week.
Many systems prioritize recent places. Does the reroute suggestion show a label like ‘frequent’ or ‘recent’ when it appears?
That tag indicates the source. A side-by-side test—cleared history vs. normal history—can show whether suggestions depend on stored places.
I’ll clear history and see what it proposes.
If suggestions change markedly after clearing, storage was likely driving the picks.
